Chapter 1

The rain had not stopped for three days, and the mountain path had turned into a river of mud.

Yun Che stopped at the edge of the cliff and looked down at the swirling clouds below. Somewhere down there was the village that had exiled him — and somewhere beyond it, the sect that would regret everything.

"You shouldn't be here," a voice said behind him.

ad

He turned slowly. The old man from the shrine stood under a broken umbrella, holding a sword wrapped in cloth.

“Neither should you,” Yun Che said.
